items.title: Steadier Sources
items.text: A fault that could close the app when many addons answered at once, as on the first press of Sources, is fixed.

items.title: Lighter on your TV
items.text: Memory is kept within bounds while addons answer, and handed back without stalling the picture.

items.title: Plug in a drive, that is all
items.text: The USB check stops cleanly when the drive is pulled out, touches only its own files, and OK hides it.
